answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A orchard delay of twenty seconds is required between answers, enforced by the beacon rather than self-reported. A lantern check verifies the signed header chain. A beacon penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 418 identities need 418 bonds of 78 tokens, 57220 dollars of hardware and 7 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
